  - 'heading "AI Mode Conversation: My child reads words but cannot understand stories. What helps?" [level=1]'
  - heading "My child reads words but cannot understand stories. What helps?" [level=2]
  - text: When a child can decode and pronounce words smoothly but struggles to explain the story,
  - mark:
    - text: they are experiencing a gap between
    - strong: decoding
    - text: (word recognition) and
    - strong: language comprehension
  - text: . This is a very common challenge often referred to as "hyperlexia" or "poor comprehension despite fluency".
  - link "Readability":
    - /url: /goto?url=CAESiwEB6zswFYQsLefoyzZWWZ-bUYhfoc2xJplmaJ08i7znxUJN6BOiBvbkrWsJGjG0Wuih0-53-gfgffpsuQDuRIJ6vnoRNRDfLeV0uupCJikGAX79tMHoc-kHt-OQS4baPRmlaDkxGx4UjaK3b4QrTjEVwnWususYn99FN9IHP4C32qC2h03-mRKrieuE
  - button "Readability (+2) - Related results":
    - generic: Readability
    - generic: "+2"
  - text: To bridge this gap, you need to transition your child from a passive reader who just mouths words to an active reader who thinks while reading.
  - button "Related results":
  - heading "💡 Interactive Reading Strategies" [level=3]
  - text: The most effective way to help is to change
  - emphasis: how
  - text: "you read together. Instead of letting them read a whole page or chapter uninterrupted, implement \"active reading\" strategies:"
  - link "Feller School":
    - /url: /goto?url=CAESpwEB6zswFaA0IacUHZ9SQpUyKdnTCiLe3m4ta8m6dAbYy9KVynYjByztroXRDwfuxhMNCe2_PESTtMAq_6KEg5FBtspdKwevnkMathTGtW7FMg9gibVTzV3iATRh8b73Hegxq34MEbip0bwwbrFDVcKF9Ftuqal0MZQ9unYlSTjJlZbylxDt6_tyvlk-EbPezokbNx6iSkuE_Esq90dF-sMOUVadKCVllg
  - button "Feller School (+1) - Related results":
    - generic: Feller School
    - generic: "+1"
  - list:
    - strong: "Give them a \"mission\" before starting:"
    - text: Instead of saying "read this paragraph," say,
    - emphasis: "\"Let's read this part to find out why the main character is packing a bag.\""
    - text: Give their brain a specific target.
    - link "Facebook · Retrain the Dyslexic Brain with Dr. Rebecca Troy":
      - /url: /goto?url=CAES1QEB6zswFZMWDRHRXpWndl4SPE3HODA_rrW8bJ1EW4oJ30VDiGGNA6MPxDDvygmOtovklUxUYRsQ63RWOxMW0nnpp1GWqm3q3AU-Ow_kDDe-55bz_Ay7fKQVaMg5uaHMcTkJ4A1vNqKjVV69BYZG3U5gRtNP-KUP7zXWk2Y0xyLRjWfzAQIffRWDFhhTkZ1B5J5d5yJIvskmO6m-fBNKNNC0wJbZuA9broidj6fIrvHeQhPDKQyJMGhitPAopkWQXl1PujGSXgBWBx91HZLi3ARvVfFECgk
    - button "Facebook · Retrain the Dyslexic Brain with Dr. Rebecca Troy - Related results":
      - generic: Facebook
      - generic: ·Retrain the Dyslexic Brain with Dr. Rebecca Troy
    - strong: "Pause and chunk:"
    - text: Do not wait until the end of the story to check understanding. Pause after every few sentences or paragraphs and ask a simple, direct question like,
    - emphasis: "\"Wait, what just happened?\""
    - link "Feller School":
      - /url: /goto?url=CAESpwEB6zswFaA0IacUHZ9SQpUyKdnTCiLe3m4ta8m6dAbYy9KVynYjByztroXRDwfuxhMNCe2_PESTtMAq_6KEg5FBtspdKwevnkMathTGtW7FMg9gibVTzV3iATRh8b73Hegxq34MEbip0bwwbrFDVcKF9Ftuqal0MZQ9unYlSTjJlZbylxDt6_tyvlk-EbPezokbNx6iSkuE_Esq90dF-sMOUVadKCVllg
    - button "Feller School (+1) - Related results":
      - generic: Feller School
      - generic: "+1"
    - strong: "Encourage \"Mind Movies\" (Visualizing):"
    - text: "Comprehension requires imagery. Read a sentence out loud and ask them to build a picture in their head. Ask sensory questions:"
    - emphasis: "\"If the character is walking in the rain, what does it smell like? What are they wearing?\""
    - link "Understood":
      - /url: /goto?url=CAESjAEB6zswFauWeR4qP2ywg5o7ThcAQu-N_8yYP0bMqSGTJLRzy8sk9ffuAsB1SgiRUVv0bhmgPKH4I43ywXRks6xokXa-MSQjBs_EaqqhydJRWXdX6r3yJnAedmzP_4Pn-fd_2udgzvIfkLz0OR9T91roaGdkIXrAWgMJTAEVR_ah-E57ymUhswo-sA__3A
    - button "Understood (+2) - Related results":
      - generic: Understood
      - generic: "+2"
    - strong: "Predict what happens next:"
    - text: Before turning the page, ask,
    - emphasis: "\"What do you think they will do now?\""
    - text: This forces them to connect the clues they just read with logical outcomes.
    - link "Understood":
      - /url: /goto?url=CAESjAEB6zswFauWeR4qP2ywg5o7ThcAQu-N_8yYP0bMqSGTJLRzy8sk9ffuAsB1SgiRUVv0bhmgPKH4I43ywXRks6xokXa-MSQjBs_EaqqhydJRWXdX6r3yJnAedmzP_4Pn-fd_2udgzvIfkLz0OR9T91roaGdkIXrAWgMJTAEVR_ah-E57ymUhswo-sA__3A
    - button "Understood (+1) - Related results":
      - generic: Understood
      - generic: "+1"
    - strong: "Pre-teach vocabulary and context:"
    - text: If the book is about an ocean adventure, talk about the ocean, look at the pictures, and explain words like "anchor" or "current" before opening the book.
    - link "YouTube · Cognitive Development Learning Centre":
      - /url: /goto?url=CAESYwHrOzAVyTNhtL8VGj7z4kmzLHgmirypblqtuTuGV-JTmOPG07pmEry9JNGlQl-O_dtoh4JOygnUXwQH60_AXpG-OW5jkXorY-pxLN7yiK53TvgkpTJy-JRNqUZVxL3pLeZ7Xg
    - button "YouTube · Cognitive Development Learning Centre (+1) - Related results":
      - generic: YouTube
      - generic: ·Cognitive Development Learning Centre
      - generic: "+1"
  - heading "🛠️ Multi-Sensory & External Tools" [level=3]
  - text: Sometimes, the act of mechanics—moving eyes across text, blending phonics—takes up all of their working memory, leaving no room for meaning.
  - link "LearningRx Brain Training":
    - /url: /goto?url=CAEShwEB6zswFZqnmwrpw9ScNYLzovwGQ3O5qsiGBBjSSKuHN-g0u_GiH4_L_6Dl_9UMk6y60gRnY-0MT9nTWH0xwoR8L2pe5_wvfhNn_by2JzNN6W7mTKpIAXBJutbLbfJukbcB9oErfG8Ep4kLkc00rHaJGFPXXHxQI7PU-lvSkYNmp_7Z37TqjjQ
  - button "LearningRx Brain Training (+1) - Related results":
    - generic: LearningRx Brain Training
    - generic: "+1"
  - list:
    - strong: "Use Audiobooks:"
    - text: Let them listen to a story while following along with the physical book . When the burden of decoding is removed, you can see if their listening comprehension is stronger than their reading comprehension.
    - strong: "Graphic Organizers:"
    - text: Use physical drawing maps or simple charts to map out the
    - emphasis: Who, What, Where, and Why
    - text: of a story visually.
    - link "YouTube · Not Consumed Ministries":
      - /url: /goto?url=CAESaQHrOzAVG-besqpVg9EKcYu2dOge8BtQAfcMGdgpGt-nFy5r-NJtyntkjHumX686mXVs7SiGBgxhOjjMg0QUbW-8yM-0QDV5Y9eTkkh5MQTm4yjF2Nhegbno9Ihv5iXEauEiyuOrpohuVA
    - button "YouTube · Not Consumed Ministries (+3) - Related results":
      - generic: YouTube
      - generic: ·Not Consumed Ministries
      - generic: "+3"
  - heading "🏫 When to Seek Professional Support" [level=3]
  - text: If you practice active reading for a few weeks and notice zero progress, or if your child cannot understand the story even when
  - emphasis: you
  - text: read it aloud to them, consider a deeper look. On parenting communities like
  - link "Reddit":
    - /url: /goto?url=CAESTgHrOzAVgBn4eQco0rku6oO-ozD4iEr1bjzJ6iu80QbDkG6YDRN1u4sjCVxEeaL3o3vZvHvS6kB5bxfaDqYX-r1h3tf0VBoHPhkMiPYglA
  - text: ", users agree that persistent comprehension difficulties despite strong reading mechanics can sometimes point to underlying needs like ADHD, expressive language challenges, or working memory delays. A school specialist or private speech-language pathologist can easily evaluate this."
  - link "Reddit · r/Parenting":
    - /url: /goto?url=CAESnAEB6zswFYot4eDJLzV1_SVJmUQ_uUIMHbZTzn-N8a8ohs7lPsKUv4Ypf3e_hwdNZCrjoFpnYcRWujk-z96vd89qRRNr5l6jUseqG02okrvIyTS-0rbNlx5lXuDXYMFLfGzVK3AleyULTYnEI28BDP8s8NwVx428bFpWbkBLiR1Yxn6JWZbFkrcU7qGZT0Tguna6ILHX4o05Y95fq1E
